title: Target markers and extra activation
summary: Dependency markers depend on the target environment. Python-version and extra markers can be evaluated from declared static metadata; platform and implementation markers require target facts absent from this collector.
checks: Use the target cfg Python version for supported markers and recursively propagate requested extras.
Preserve unknown for platform/implementation markers or direct URL requirements rather than use collector defaults.
limitations: The target interpreter is never queried; unavailable target facts are not borrowed from the collector.
applicability: POSIX CPython venv metadata for Python 3.11-3.14; static evidence only
